in_sanskrit.name: चोटा
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The Sanskrit term चोटा (chota) is derived from the word चित्रम् (chitram), which means 'small', 'little', or 'minute'. This term is often used to describe things that are diminutive in size or significance.

in_hindi.name: चोटा
in_hindi.long_meaning: The Hindi term चोटा (chota) is derived from the term समालोचन (samalochan), which means 'little' or 'small'. This term is commonly used in everyday language to describe things that are of small size or significance.

in_tamil.name: சோடா
in_tamil.long_meaning: The Tamil term சோடா (chota) is derived from the term சோடு (chotu), which means 'small' or 'little'. This term is frequently used in Tamil language to describe things that are of small size or significance.

in_telugu.name: చోదా
in_telugu.long_meaning: The Telugu term చోదా (chota) is derived from the term చోదు (chodu), which means 'small' or 'little'. This term is commonly used in the Telugu language to describe things that are of small size or significance.
